typicalChallenges: How does the architecture demonstrate compliance with NCSC security principles and Secure by Design?
What evidence exists that security compliance is continuously maintained rather than point-in-time assessed?
How are compliance gaps identified and tracked through to remediation?
What is the process for assessing compliance impact of architecture changes?
What operational procedures are needed to maintain compliance (log retention, access reviews, patching)?
How will compliance drift be detected and remediated in production?
What is the operational burden of compliance reporting and evidence collection?
How are compliance requirements communicated to operations teams for day-to-day enforcement?
How are compliance requirements integrated into the development workflow and definition of done?
What automated compliance checks are in the CI/CD pipeline?
How will compliance requirements affect delivery timelines and sprint planning?
What training do developers need to understand and implement compliance requirements?
What is the cost of achieving and maintaining compliance (tooling, audits, training, staffing)?
What are the financial penalties for non-compliance versus the cost of compliance measures?
How do compliance requirements affect the overall project budget and timeline?
Are there shared compliance services that could reduce per-project compliance costs?
